Overview

Laura opens on a setup screen and never starts by itself. Pick countdown, Pomodoro or stopwatch, press Start, and a full-screen split-flap clock takes over, with soft piano, rain or brown noise behind it if you want. No sign-up, no cloud and no network access at all.

  • 17background sounds in four groups
  • 3modes: countdown, Pomodoro, stopwatch
  • 3platforms from one codebase
  • 0network requests, ever

What it does

01A real split-flap clock

Built by hand: hinge line, shading and a mechanical flip on every digit. No clock package.

02Three ways to focus

Countdown with presets, Pomodoro with short and long breaks, or a stopwatch.

03Music that behaves

Piano, ambient, nature and noise. It pauses with the timer and can keep playing through breaks.

04A gentle finish

Six completion sounds, from a soft bell to a harp, each with a preview.

05History

Every session with its mode, planned and actual time, and how it ended.

06Private by default

No accounts, no tracking and no internet permission.

For the technical reader

How it's built

  • Flutter
  • Dart
  • SoLoud audio
  1. flutter_soloud for gapless, low-latency audio.
  2. Six real Bach piano recordings from the public-domain Open Goldberg Variations.
  3. The flip clock is drawn by hand, digit by digit.
  4. Released as an Android .apk and a Linux .deb.
